remarks: Stunning Coastal Condo with Loft & Expansive Balcony Beautifully renovated, this 2-bedroom plus loft, ranch-style condo is perfectly situated in a sought-after coastal community. Designed for modern living, it features an open floor plan, high ceilings, and abundant natural light, creating an inviting and airy atmosphere.  The spacious family room is the heart of the home, complete with a large fireplace, oversized windows, and direct access to a private balcony-ideal for morning coffee or evening relaxation. The dining room flows seamlessly between the kitchen and family room, perfect for entertaining. The well-appointed kitchen features stainless steel appliances and lots of counter space. There is a full laundry area in unit. The generously sized bedrooms offer ample closet space. The primary suite boasts an ensuite bath. Loft area offers extra space for flexible uses. Assigned parking and storage areas as well. Located in a meticulously maintained complex, this home offers the perfect blend of privacy and community. Enjoy a large pool, tennis court, serene park-like grounds with a pond, and a community garden area. This unit is close to the pool-without being too close for noise concerns.  Ideally located for easy commuting, nearby beaches, and just minutes from Rowayton's charming village shops and restaurants, as well as everything Norwalk has to offer.
